A centered frontal head-and-shoulders portrait of a child, from the top of the head to the upper chest, with a pure solid white seamless background. The child is facing directly forward, head upright, eyes looking straight into the camera, and displaying a relaxed, natural, and neutral facial expression. 

The final image must show only the bare neck, shoulders, clavicle area, and upper chest, without any visible clothing, shirt, collar, fabric, accessories, necklaces, scarves, or any costume elements. The subject must appear as a clean bare-shoulder bust portrait suitable for ID photo or skin reference use.

If the input image is already a frontal bust portrait, preserve the original composition exactly: identical position, size, scale, framing, crop, silhouette, contour boundary, and occupied area in the frame:2.0.

If the input image is not a frontal bust portrait, convert it into a standardized frontal bust ID photo composition while preserving the child’s original identity, facial features, facial bone structure, head shape, face shape, original hairstyle, and natural skin appearance.

The child must remain centered in the canvas, face aligned with the vertical centerline, head perfectly upright, shoulders naturally horizontal, ID photo style composition, clean high-key studio portrait.

Preserve the original identity, facial bone structure, skull shape, face shape, jawline, cheekbones, brow bone, nose bridge, chin shape, facial proportions, eye spacing, eye shape, eyebrow shape, nose shape, mouth shape, lip shape, and ear visibility:1.6.

Do not alter the natural bone structure, facial morphology, facial contour, head shape, face width, cheekbone height, jaw angle, chin length, nose structure, nose bridge, or facial proportions:1.6.

Fully retain the original hairstyle, original hairline, original hair volume, original hair direction, original hair contour, natural hair texture, and realistic hair strand details:1.5.

Natural matte delicate skin, realistic child skin texture, natural healthy warm skin tone with soft ruddy undertones, natural facial blood circulation, healthy complexion, not pale, not gray, not cold white. Natural moist lip color, subtle natural lip texture.

Highly detailed realistic child skin texture:1.6. Visible natural pores on the forehead, nose, cheeks, chin, and around the mouth area:1.6. Fine epidermis texture, subtle uneven skin micro-texture, tiny pores, natural sebaceous texture, slight skin translucency, faint capillaries, and naturally visible fine blood vessels under the skin:1.5.

Natural micro imperfections, subtle tonal variations, realistic skin grain, no beauty filter, no excessive retouching, no plastic smoothing:1.5.

Soft and even frontal studio lighting, high-key ID photo lighting, large softbox lighting from the camera front and slightly above eye level, approximately 15–30 degree downward angle, very soft low-contrast shadows, gentle shadow under nose and chin, no harsh directional shadows.

Pure solid white seamless background, clean high-key studio background, no extra elements, no debris, no stains, no shadows, no color blocks, no distractions.

Camera position at eye level or slightly below eye level, frontal 0-degree angle, no head tilt, no perspective distortion. Portrait lens look similar to Canon EF 85mm f/1.2, natural low-distortion portrait perspective, equivalent 85mm studio portrait perspective, no wide-angle distortion.
